output.reason: Evidence supports that a pre-payment charge baseline of 2% applies (“Pre-payment charges: 2% of the amount prepaid”) and that, for certain loans, a RBI/UCB direction can prohibit levying pre-payment charges (e.g., a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on specified floating rate business-purpose loans to individuals and MSEs with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh, for loans sanctioned/renewed on or after Jan 1, 2026). Evidence also states that in other cases, pre-payment charges (if any) are as per the UCB’s approved policy. However, the claim that the bank’s own and MSE business loan sanction letters “state” the 2% figure and that the policy applies only when RBI directions do not prohibit is not directly supported, because no sanction-letter text is provided.
